records.notes: Vector-path extraction of the solid line of one panel; exact to PDF coordinate precision. Axes calibrated from tick marks (the figure has no text layer; the label values are read from the rendered figure). Only 0 number printed in a paper can be compared with this panel; its calibration rests on the common layout of the nine panels (tick spacing identical to 0.00 pt), which was checked against printed numbers in the panels z = 0.1, 1, 1.5, 3 and 6.

selection.warning: Digitized from the vector paths of a figure (not computed from the simulation), so never rankable. Luminosities are model nebular emission computed in post-processing (photoionization models coupled to the simulated gas and stars), not simulation output, and carry no dust attenuation outside H II regions, so the curve belongs with dust-corrected observations, not with attenuated ones. The galaxy sample is those above the stellar-mass cut (the paper: nebular emission is computed 'for all these galaxies and their progenitors at z>0'); whether the cut is applied again at each redshift is not stated. The curve has a peak at log L = 42.60 (the paper: peaks 'arise from the resolution limits; galaxy number densities below the peak are incomplete and hence not meaningful'); points at and below the peak are not written. The density axis is labelled Mpc^-3 without saying comoving.
